_cleanupPeriodDays_comment: Transcript retention in DAYS. Claude Code deletes ~/.claude/projects/**.jsonl older than this ON STARTUP; the built-in default when this key is ABSENT is 30 days. 2026-08-20: discovered ~2.5 months of history (mid-May to late-July) had been silently swept - .claude/ was created 2026-05-15 but the oldest surviving resumable transcript was 2026-07-30. No btrfs snapshots existed to recover from (@snapshots/home-diego was empty). Only ~/.claude/history.jsonl survived, which holds prompts but not replies or tool output. 36500 = 100 years = never delete. Cost is disk: transcripts accrue at roughly 85MB/day, so prune by hand if ~/.claude/projects gets uncomfortable rather than lowering this back down.

permissions._deny_comment: Read on image files is denied so base64 images never enter a session transcript. 2026-08-12: session 1ec8fac3 (31MB, 16k lines) would not compact — it stalled at 95% every attempt. Five of its entries were base64 images from Read, four of them 1.0-1.3MB each. Compaction re-sends the WHOLE conversation to be summarised, and an image is atomic: unlike text it cannot be truncated or dropped, so every retry re-transmits it. There is no way to strip them at compact time either — PreCompact can only BLOCK or allow compaction (see 2.1.212 changelog), it cannot rewrite the transcript. So the only lever is keeping them out of the transcript in the first place. NOTE this is a real tradeoff: Claude can no longer LOOK at screenshots/diagrams, which is genuinely useful for UI work. Drop the relevant line to re-enable, or run that session with --permission-mode bypassPermissions.
permissions._allow_comment: Read-only inspection commands that prompted repeatedly across the last 50 sessions (2026-08-20 transcript scan of 64k tool calls). Only non-mutating forms are listed: systemctl/journalctl QUERY subcommands (is-active/show/cat/status/list-units, -u/-b/-k log reads) and `gh run watch`. Deliberately NOT here: systemctl start/stop/restart, gh workflow run, gh release download, docker pull, nix build, and any interpreter or `env`/`bash`/`python3` form, since a wildcard on those is arbitrary code execution. 2026-08-23: added `mcp__cloud-infra` - a SERVER-WIDE grant on the c3-infra-mcp server (Claude Code MCP rules take `mcp__<server>` for all tools or `mcp__<server>__<tool>` for one; `mcp__<server>__*` is NOT a supported form). This is deliberately broader than the Bash policy above and does cover mutating verbs (devops_service_start, devops_container_restart, devops_docker_compose_up, devops_build_ship, devops_vm_stop, devops_secrets_set). Rationale: every fleet repair routed through this server was being denied one tool at a time, and the server is our own authenticated infra API behind Authelia bearer + the wg mesh gate - not arbitrary code execution. Narrow it back to per-tool entries if that trust boundary ever changes. Commands Claude Code already auto-allows (cat/ls/head/tail/grep/rg/jq/find/sed/ps/git read-only/gh view+list/docker ps) are intentionally omitted - they never prompt and an entry would be dead weight. 2026-08-23: listed twice as mcp__cloud-infra AND mcp__c3-infra-mcp - the tool prefix follows the MCP server key, and this one server is keyed cloud-infra in the user config but c3-infra-mcp in cloud's .mcp.json, so a single name silently fails to grant under the other. Note mcp__<server>__* is NOT a supported wildcard form; the bare mcp__<server> entry IS the server-wide grant.

_extraKnownMarketplaces_comment: Registers the cloud-marketplace plugin dir. 2026-08-12: this existed ONLY in the runtime ~/.claude/settings.json and was declared nowhere, so every switch wiped it — home.activation.claudeSettings rebuilds the file from source and preserves exactly one runtime key (effortLevel). The value is fully derivable (@HOME@/.claude/cloud-marketplace, deployed by this same module), so it belongs in the declaration rather than depending on Claude Code re-registering it after each rebuild.
_enableAllProjectMcpServers_comment: Auto-trust a project's own .mcp.json servers instead of prompting per-server. The fleet's .mcp.json files are machine-derived from a_solutions/*/build.json (all our own servers), so blanket-trust is safe here. Mirrored into every repo's committed .claude/settings.json (0_apps/src/claude/settings.json) so fresh clones with no ~/.claude — CI, containers, Claude Code on the web — auto-load them too; this copy covers ~/.claude on home-manager machines.
_skillOverrides_comment: Suppresses the recurring 'Teach auto mode about your environment?' prompt.
because answering 'Not now' defers rather than dismisses, and nothing else was
recording an answer. The prompt is gated in the CLI on
so setting the override to 'off' turns it off at the source instead of relying on
a per-machine dismissal flag. It belongs HERE and not in ~/.claude/settings.json:
that file is generated from this one on every switch and keeps exactly one runtime
key (effortLevel), so a hand-dismissal written there is wiped by the next switch
